title: composite-latency-and-packetloss-pop-routing-gate
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a region selection gate that fuses latency quantiles (p50 and p95) with network health signals derived from packet loss and jitter to produce a single path-grade score used by the geo-router. The gate should support hysteresis, soft-eviction, and transparent fallback to lower-cost or more-robust model variants when path-grade drops below safety thresholds. This ticket covers scoring design, API surface for the router, integration points for telemetry collectors, and an initial rollout plan with canary and metrics to watch.
background: Current geo-router primarily uses latency percentiles sampled per-pop. We observed outages where p50/p95 alone missed circuit-level packet loss spikes (short-lived but high-traffic) that caused tail latency and throughput degradation. Operators want a single, explainable score that captures both latency behavior and path integrity so routing decisions avoid transiently unhealthy POPs while minimizing unnecessary failovers.
proposal_summary: 1) Compute per-POP metrics: rolling p50, p95 (1m/5m windows), packet loss rate (EWMA over 30s/5m), and jitter (ms EWMA). 2) Normalize each metric to a 0..1 risk scale (0 healthy, 1 unhealthy) using configurable thresholds and logistic smoothing. 3) Fuse into a path-grade score: weighted sum with dynamic weights that favor p95 under high client-SLOs and favor packet-loss under throughput-sensitive routes. 4) Apply time-decay and hysteresis: require sustained degradation for N samples or an aggregate drop > X before soft-eviction. 5) When a POP is evicted, attempt fallback routing to a compatible variant or region; enable configurable fallback policies by customer tier.
acceptance_criteria: Router exposes new /routing/score endpoint that returns path-grade and contributing metric breakdown for each POP
Path-grade computed using p50/p95 and packet-loss/jitter per proposal with default thresholds in config
Hysteresis implemented: single short spike < configured window must not trigger eviction; sustained issues do
Fallback behavior: router can switch to a compatible model variant and record decision in trace logs
Dashboard shows per-POP path-grade trend, contribution bars, and an incident playbook link

rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal-only scoring computed and logged alongside existing metrics (2 weeks). Phase 2: soft-runner - router records decisions but does not evict; compare decisions to current behavior (1 week). Phase 3: canary enablement for 10% traffic in non-critical regions with automated rollback on error budget burn (2 weeks). Phase 4: gradual ramp to 100% after 1 week of stable signals.
safety_and_rollback: Default safety: require 3 consecutive scoring windows showing >0.25 drop in path-grade before eviction. Automatic rollback triggers on sustained 10% increase in cross-pop error rate or >0.5% SLO burn within canary. Provide manual override via console and ability to pin POPs.
implementation_notes:
- Use existing telemetry ingestion (kinesis->metrics-store) and add lightweight packet-loss counter at edge-proxy.
- Keep normalization parameters feature-flagged per-customer.
- Store per-POP last-eviction-reason in routing index for debugging.
- Ensure scoring computation is O(1) per POP per window to keep router latency predictable.
